Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7197064778 on PR #37614, N1 and its out-of-diff notes)

## What happens

The i18n skill and two spec comments still say the i18n service registers its own HTTP routes. On `main` it mounts none: the `I18nServicePlugin` class docblock in `packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts` says so since #23347, and `createDispatcherPlugin` in `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` mounts the three `/api/v1/i18n/*` paths.

- [ ] `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the Registration sentence ("It self-registers `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`, …"): name the dispatcher as the route owner. `skills/**` is Tier H.
- [ ] The docblock near `GetLocalesResponseSchema` in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (about :4863) and the `toLocaleDescriptors` comment in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`: the same correction.
- [ ] Optional, same section of the skill: the methods list omits `getSourceLocale`, `setSourceLocale` and `getFallbackLocale`, which both shipped adapters implement.

Category ①: a shipped skill states a wrong fact about where a route comes from.
Priority: p3. Only someone composing a kernel by hand reads it wrong; `os serve` users are unaffected.
Business reason: a developer who wires a kernel without the dispatcher expects the i18n routes from the service and gets none.
Reader: seat 2 area s2-ux-T (repo:objectstack#2).
Dedupe: `i18n self-registers locales route dispatcher` (open issues), 0 hits.
Related: #36873, PR #37614, #23347.
